membership.note: 81 stocks Bisnis.com listed as leaving IHSG calculation on 2 November 2026, as announced in IDX's index rebalancing. IDX publishes HSC notices per issuer and the exchange's own list was not found. Bisnis.com reported 82 HSC stocks on 23 October. Last week's 80-name list (Katadata, 19 October) differs from this list by FILM and TFCO added and KING absent.

method: Full market value = shares outstanding on 30 October x daily close, from the owner's read-only Flowless database. Group value lost = sum over falling stocks of shares x (close on 23 October - close on 30 October). Group change = sum(shares x close on 30 October) / sum(shares x close on 23 October) - 1. Shares outstanding are held at their 30 October counts for both dates, so the totals show price moves only. IDX's own market capitalisation also counts shares newly issued during the week. Trading share uses regular-market value for 26 to 30 October. These are full-value weights, not IHSG capped free-float weights.
